Uses and Administration Nutmeg is the source of nutmeg oil (below). It is aromatic and carminative and is used as a flavour. Nutmeg has been reported to inhibit prostaglandin synthesis. Homoeopathy. Nutmeg has been used in homoeopathic med- icines under the following names: Myristica fragrans; Nux mos- chata; Nux. mos.
